content.tex: INVESTIGATION REGULAR STARS
This investigation is about the construction of regular stars and their properties. Here are some regular stars.

parts.text: You can also make regular stars by joining dots that are equally spaced round a circle. Here is a star made by joining every second dot round a circle with 5 equally spaced dots. This 3-point star is made by connecting every second dot round a circle with 6 equally spaced dots. Regular polygons are also regular stars and their vertices are the points of the star.
